- Plan: Optimizing end-to-end supply chain processes, demand forecasting, inventory management, and digital transformation.

- Source: Driving sourcing excellence, strategic negotiations, procurement transformation, and cost optimization.

- Deliver: Improving logistics, transportation efficiency, network optimization and operational execution.

As an Operations Consultant, focused in Source, you will lead defined work streams within Kearney Activate client engagements and help clients solve complex, procurement and related supply chain and operations challenges. You will combine functional expertise, structured problem-solving, and strong communication to design practical solutions and support implementation.

The role is suited to a professional who can own work products end to end, work directly with client stakeholders, and contribute to the continued development of Kearney Activate capabilities.

Source
- Lead procurement assessments, diagnostics, and transformation initiatives.

- Execute sourcing work including establishing baselines, cost models, market intelligence, RFX execution, analysis and negotiation strategy.

- Lead teams in applying the latest in digital and AI-backed tools and approaches to drive procurement work streams using a range of Kearney proprietary and third-party solutions

- Develop recommendations related to sourcing excellence, supplier performance, and procurement of operating models.

- Lead clients, independently or with small teams, in change management to ensure value realization with program management, savings tracking, and supplier transition steps

End-to-end Operations impact

- Account for broader supply chain impact in designing process improvements, analytical models, performance measures, and implementation of roadmaps.

Kearney Activate and Client Development

- Contribute to proposals, client pitches and business development initiatives.

- Work flexibly in dynamic environments with varying client needs and project requirements.

- Develop intellectual capital, tools, methods, and case studies.

- Support Kearney outreach and collaborate with technology and asset-development teams.

Who You Are

- 5-7 years of experience in consulting, supply chain, procurement, operations or transformation.

- Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients or North American operating environments is a plus.

- Strong ownership, communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.

- Ability to structure complex problems, develop actionable recommendations, and present to senior stakeholders.

- Comfortable analyzing large datasets and developing advanced Excel models.

- Proficiency and ability to guide team in using LLM platforms (ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate workflows for research, and deliverable deployment and validation.

- Knowledge of tools such as Coupa, Jaggaer or Keelvar, and other Source-to-contract solutions, with the ability to guide clients and project teams on usage.

- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms is a plus.

- Knowledge of Procure-to-Pay process and systems a plus

- Willingness to travel to client locations when required.

Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:

- Generous retirement savings contributions.

- Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and their families.

jobs.title: Prokura Norway - Associate Consultant / Consultant - 2026
jobs.description:
Ready for an extraordinary career? Join Prokura to tackle exciting challenges in optimizing strategic operations for our clients. Work with top-notch specialists and leverage the resources of our parent company, Kearney. Make a real difference with our determination, pragmatic mindset, flexible delivery, and candid culture. Experience a unique Nordic-style consultancy and real opportunities for growth. We are professional and ambitious, yet down-to-earth in how we work and interact with our clients, with low hierarchy and a high level of trust . Unleash your potential and join us today!
You have a unique possibility to apply for a  full-time position as Associate Consultant or Consultant , depending on the experience, in Norway becoming a part of our great team. The start date will be agreed individually.
Who Are We?
Prokura is a leading management consultancy specializing in Procurement and Supply Chain. Our team of 120 professionals, located in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Middle East and Japan, provides consulting services to large corporations across industries such as energy, private equity, pharmaceutical and retail.
What You’ll do
- Contribute to structured problem-solving in collaboration with senior colleagues by proactively identifying issues and opportunities and solutions.
- Apply your understanding of strategic operation processes, tools and concepts.
- Work effectively with external stakeholders and take responsibility for developing strong relationships with key clients.
- Take ownership for advocating and promoting Prokura values and culture both on and outside projects.
- Show strong personal drive and take process ownership of your work by scoping own time and meeting deadlines.
- Take ownership of personal development, identifying areas for improvement and opportunities to strengthen your personal skills.
- Make decisions regarding your own work and take responsibility for learning from mistakes.
- Build a solid consulting toolbox through core skills such as communication, Excel, PowerPoint, and the effective use of different AI tools in problem-solving, analysis, and delivery.

Who You Are
We are looking for ambitious and motivated early-career professionals with 0–2 years of relevant experience who are eager to learn and grow in management consulting. As an Associate Consultant or Consultant, you’ll be challenged to think critically and solve complex problems from day one.
We are looking for candidates who…
- Are motivated individuals with a strong academic record in relevant subjects such as finance, supply chain, or economics.
- Have 0–2 years of relevant experience within management consulting or a comparable field .
- Have a genuine interest in management consulting.
- Are ambitious, motivated, and bring a high level of energy combined with a collaborative working style.
- Possess analytical and communication skills.
- Are fluent in both English and Norwegian.

Remember, you don't need to meet all the criteria above – we encourage you to apply if you believe you could be a good fit for our team.
What we offer
- Responsibility from Day One: At Prokura, we believe in giving you responsibility early on, but never without support. From day one, you’ll work on real projects and contribute meaningfully to your team, while being surrounded by experienced colleagues who are invested in your success.
- An Environment for growth : We’re deeply committed to your professional and personal development. From day one, you’ll be included in our Learning & Development program, starting with a two-week onboarding period alongside other new joiners from across our offices. This includes training sessions designed to give you the tools, frameworks, and confidence you need to succeed, whether it’s mastering Excel, PowerPoint or learning to structure and break down complex problems. Our strong feedback culture ensures that you receive regular, constructive input from colleagues and managers, helping you reflect, adapt and continuously improve as a consultant.
- A strong Mentoring program : A dedicated mentor will help you set your personal and professional goals, reflect on your development, and guide you along your journey. In addition, you’ll be assigned a buddy even before your first day, who will be available to answer all your questions and help you feel welcomed and supported throughout your onboarding.
- A Culture where you can thrive : We believe that enjoying your work, and the people you work with, is essential to long-term success. That’s why we’ve built a strong, vibrant social culture across all our offices. One of our longest-standing traditions is the Friday breakfast in the Oslo office. A weekly highlight and a warm way to round off the week together with colleagues across teams. We have a lot of fun together, whether it’s company retreats abroad, cabin trips, Team Days, or more casual moments like breakfast at Sommerro, lunch at Theatercafeen, and Friday bars. There’s always something to look forward to. Our Sports Committee keeps us active with Barry’s before breakfast, social runs, tennis, and more. At Prokura, we take pride in creating a workplace where people feel supported, included, and genuinely enjoy being part of the team.
- And of course… Beyond everything above, a Flat hierarchy and Competitive compensation are a given when you join us at Prokura. You’ll be a part of a team where your voice matters, no matter your title, and where your contributions are recognized both professionally and personally.

How to Apply:
To apply, please send us your CV, transcript and a motivational letter. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.
This is a unique opportunity to develop your career in management consulting with Prokura - send us your application today!

jobs.title: Prokura Senior Consultant 2026
jobs.description:
Prokura – A Kearney Company
Prokura wurde 2008 gegründet und hat sich seitdem als führende Unternehmensberatung in Skandinavien im Bereich Einkauf und Supply Chain Management etabliert. Unser 120-köpfiges Team aus unseren Standorten in Dänemark, Norwegen, Schweden, Deutschland und Großbritannien berät sowohl Großkonzerne und mittelständische Unternehmen als auch den öffentlichen Sektor. Prokura ist seit 2022 ein eigenständiger Teil von Kearney, einer globalen Strategieberatung. Damit ist der Weg für weiteres Wachstum gesichert: Das umfangreiche internationale Netzwerk und die renommierte Marke von Kearney gebündelt mit der Start-up-Atmosphäre bei Prokura ermöglichen es uns, die Erfolgsgeschichte in Deutschland fortzuschreiben. Die Projekteinsätze von Prokura reichen im Bereich Einkauf von der Strategieerstellung bis zur Implementierung, vom Aufbau von Einkaufsorganisationen bis zur Optimierung von Warengruppen. Auch im Bereich SCM bestreiten wir vielfältige Projekte von der Netzwerk- bis hin zu Produktions- und Lageroptimierung.

Was dich erwartet
- Spannende Projekte – weit über die Kernthemen Einkauf und Supply Chain hinaus: dabei lernst du führende Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen kennen, wie z.B. Retail, Automotive, Pharma oder Consumer Goods.
- Vielfältige Aufgaben – von der Analyse von externen Ausgaben über den Aufbau einer resilienten Supply Chain bis hin zur Entwicklung einer nachhaltigen Einkaufsorganisation. Dabei erstellen wir nicht nur Folien, sondern setzen unsere Konzepte auch gemeinsam mit dem Klienten um.
- Internationale Projektarbeit – bei uns arbeitest du in internationalen Teams für Klienten aus verschiedensten Ländern. Einen Teil unserer Projekte führen wir gemeinsam mit Kearney durch, sodass du spannende Einblicke weit über die Prokura Kernthemen hinaus erhältst.
- Starkes Wachstum – unsere hohen Wachstumsziele bieten dir die Möglichkeit, Teil dieser großartigen Reise zu werden und deine innovativen Ideen und Fähigkeiten neben der Projektarbeit mit einzubringen. Mit Kearney als starker Muttergesellschaft haben wir die Schlagkraft, um unsere ehrgeizigen Ziele gemeinsam mit dir zu übertreffen.

Dein Profil
- Ausgezeichnete akademische Leistungen im Rahmen eines Master oder Bachelor-Abschlusses einer Universität oder Fachhochschule.
- 1 bis 2 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem Beratungsunternehmen oder in der Industrie/ Handel mit Schwerpunkt Einkauf und/oder Supply Chain Management.
- Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten, logisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen sowie Kreativität bei der Problemlösung.
- Hervorragende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch).
- Du bist ein Teamplayer mit hervorragenden zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten und hast Spaß am leistungsorientierten Arbeiten.
- Du bist motiviert, energiegeladen, kooperativ und hast einen Entrepreneurial-Spirit.

Was wir dir bieten
- Die einmalige Konstellation bietet dir das Beste aus beiden Welten: das umfangreiche, internationale Netzwerk von Kearney und gleichzeitig die Start-up-Atmosphäre bei Prokura, in der du deinen ganz persönlichen Beitrag zur Entwicklung der Firma leistest.
- Du übernimmst von Beginn an viel Verantwortung im „Training-on-the-Job“-Konzept mit Unterstützung von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen.
- Schnelle Beförderungszeiten – bei Prokura befördern wir rein auf Basis von Performance und Ambitionen, in unseren zwei Bewertungszyklen pro Jahr. So gibt es diverse Kolleg:innen, die schon zwei Mal im gleichen Jahr befördert wurden.
- Individuelle Entwicklung – kontinuierliches Feedback, ein auf dich zugeschnittener Entwicklungsplan und Unterstützung von Mentor:innen für deinen Karriereweg.
- Work-Life-Balance ist für uns als Nordic Company kein Spruch, sondern ein explizites Versprechen: Unsere Arbeitszeiten liegen weit unter dem Branchendurchschnitt.
- Junges, dynamisches und motiviertes Team, enger Zusammenhalt – regelmäßige Teamabende und internationale Firmenevents sorgen dafür, dass der Spaß neben der Arbeit nicht zu kurz kommt.
- Die Kosten für regelmäßige Reisen zu deinem Office-Standort übernimmt Prokura für dich.
- Wir legen großen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und Wertschätzung. Du sollst dich bei deiner Arbeit wohl und sicher fühlen.

Language Requirements
Fluent German language skills
